answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by tying each identity to a lotus root: an agent earns one rooted lotus identity only after a slow, public germination period, during which its behaviour is visible to all. A whisper channel lets honest agents flag suspected clones without exposing themselves, and every flag is checked against a mirror registry reflecting each identity's history. If the mirror shows two identities sharing one root, both are frozen and their stake burned. A lotus root cannot be duplicated cheaply, so forging an army of fakes costs more than any reward it could win.
